name: critical_delivery_20261105
comment: D32 section 6 / D33 (FQ-143): the CRITICAL tier is the only thing allowed on the operator's text channel.
This gate checks that the class list is the six the operator named, that the text-channel guard refuses every
other class including 'test', 'digest' and 'status', that the guard exposes no override argument, that every
address on file is a target and a non-address is refused rather than dialled, that the contact file is read from
the private persistent-state root and never from this public repository, and that the text message leads with the
action and fits 300 characters. It does not check queuing, sending, acknowledgement or receipts; those are the
next slice of FQ-143 and are not claimed here.
